chunks: Do they not see how God originates creation, then reverts it back? This is indeed how inevitably the law of God works;
ai.seo_question: How does the Quran explain the ease of resurrection for God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a logical proof for the bodily resurrection (Ba'th), urging believers to reflect on the tangible evidence of creation in the natural world as a precursor to the Hereafter. It underscores the concept of Divine Ease (Yasir), contrasting the perceived difficulty of resurrection for skeptics with the absolute simplicity of God's creative command, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on reason (Aql) alongside revelation.
